paths.description: Homepage and primary acquisition surface; desktop/mobile, preferences, privacy, performance, accessibility, network and memory.
Shop and service listing archetype, representing offer discovery and category results.
Primary registration flow first step, including field semantics and invalid submission behaviour.
Authentication form inspected for autofill and phishing-resistant authentication support.
Editorial/help content archetype and no-JavaScript resilience.
Recovery state for a nonexistent URL.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to dark color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in palette to the light capture; surfaces remain white and the platform probe found no dark-theme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces/text through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found 41 running, effectively continuous 1000 ms animations and no prefers-reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop non-essential repeating animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences are not handled and ordinary contrast already fails.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet probe found no contrast-preference adaptation; axe reported 42 serious color-contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations and fix baseline WCAG contrast.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The live stylesheet probe found no view-transition declarations on a multi-route Next.js experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: A consent interstitial obscures every public content page on load.
findings.evidence: Desktop, search, guide and campaign screenshots show a centered modal and dimmed page before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking privacy control where lawful; provide equal first-layer accept/reject actions and retain settings access.

findings.summary: The consent modal is custom div chrome rather than a native dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM structure found four role=dialog DIVs but zero dialog elements and zero popovers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal consent/settings flows with correct focus management and escape/cancel behaviour.

findings.summary: Dense advertising and promotional chrome competes with the service content.
findings.evidence: The homepage and listing screenshots are dominated by banners, offer tiles and secondary promotion; the HAR records 135 image requests and 275 third-party requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce duplicate banners and ad slots, prioritise a smaller set of high-value offers, and defer secondary modules.

findings.summary: Mobile pages render a scaled desktop canvas instead of reflowing.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport Chrome reports a 1140px layout viewport and 0.3158 visual scale because meta viewport content is empty; text and controls are tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and rebuild fixed-width layouts with intrinsic/fluid sizing.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no @container rules, while mobile screenshots show desktop cards merely scaled down.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and size-aware component layouts, retaining viewport queries only for page-level composition.

findings.guidanceId: touch target size hover fallback pointer input focus-visible
findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and mobile targets are visually tiny.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus on the first link computed outline-style none; the scaled 1140px canvas shrinks controls at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide strong :focus-visible styles and minimum 44 CSS px touch targets after correcting viewport/reflow.

findings.summary: Load performance is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports performance 47, LCP 10.3s, TBT 470ms and time-to-interactive 46.5s; the trace independently records FCP/LCP 3.55s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element, reduce early third-party work, and defer non-critical modules.

findings.summary: Main-thread work delays interactivity.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 470ms TBT and the trace recorded an 86.74ms long task.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long tasks, conditionally load advertising code, and schedule lower-priority work after interaction readiness.

findings.summary: The initial page load is very heavy and inefficient.
findings.evidence: HAR: 366 requests and 8.09MB transferred, including 5.08MB images and 660KB across 69 font requests; several large assets lack cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce font families, optimise/defer images and ads, and establish useful caching and a short critical chain.

findings.summary: Large amounts of shipped code are unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 752KiB unused JavaScript and 286KiB unused CSS, alongside 47 script requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Use code coverage to remove dead styles/scripts and load page- and consent-specific dependencies conditionally.

findings.summary: Controls and links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe found one critical unnamed button and three serious unnamed links; the image audit found 37 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable control a discernible name and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration.

findings.summary: Many text elements fail WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe reported 42 serious color-contrast failures and 75 additional nodes requiring review.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background design tokens to meet at least WCAG AA in every state.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading and focus structure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: axe found 18 region violations; DOM has no main landmark, multiple empty headings, and focused links compute outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a main landmark, remove empty headings, maintain a logical heading hierarchy and provide visible focus.

findings.summary: Mobile text is too small because the desktop page is scaled down.
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshots show an entire 1140px-wide desktop composition compressed into the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow at the device width and use fluid, readable type with comfortable line lengths.

findings.summary: The empty viewport declaration defeats proper mobile reflow and usable target sizing.
findings.evidence: DOM reports meta viewport content=""; layout resolves to 1140 CSS px at a 360px requested viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a valid viewport declaration without disabling zoom, then test reflow and target size at 320-400px.

findings.summary: The page emits browser console errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit failed with two items.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve uncaught/network console errors and keep production logging actionable.

findings.summary: Document assets are not consistently well structured.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 41 images without dimensions, 29 oversized images and 52 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image dimensions, serve responsive sources and migrate suitable raster assets to AVIF/WebP.

findings.summary: DevTools reports inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse inspector-issues audit failed with one item, although BFCache and on-load permission audits passed.
findings.suggestedFix: Review the Lighthouse inspector issue and remove the underlying deprecated or malformed platform usage.

findings.summary: Some links are not meaningfully crawlable or named.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse crawlable-anchors audit failed one item; DOM/axe found multiple unnamed links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href anchors with descriptive visible or accessible link text.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but baseline security headers and cookie flags are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; 16 of 17 observed cookies lacked Secure and many used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, HSTS and nosniff; mark HTTPS cookies Secure and choose the strictest workable SameSite policy.

findings.summary: The page exposes an exceptionally broad tracking surface before consent.
findings.evidence: Trackers observed 70 third-party origins and 21 known tracker domains; HAR attributes 275 requests and 5.49MB to third parties, while the dialog names 210 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential partners until consent, reduce the vendor list, and enforce a third-party byte/request budget.

findings.summary: Authentication disables password-manager assistance and offers no passkey path.
findings.evidence: Login probe found no passkey/WebAuthn integration; password autocomplete is explicitly off and email has no autocomplete token. Lighthouse confirms no permission prompts on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkeys/WebAuthn and use username/current-password autocomplete as a fallback.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers found no frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy in addition to no CSP/HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; consider Trusted Types for XSS-sensitive surfaces.

findings.summary: Core homepage content disappears without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability captured a blank crawler screenshot for the homepage and only 33% raw/rendered word coverage; guide and search retain partial content but explicitly require JavaScript for points.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the meaningful homepage and listing content, keeping JavaScript as enhancement for personalised or transactional features.

findings.guidanceId: offline fallback service worker web app manifest installable pwa
findings.summary: The app-like rewards service has no install/offline metadata.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no web app manifest; no offline fallback was exposed during recon.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a manifest and service-worker offline fallback for browsable guide/listing content and graceful flow errors.

findings.summary: The consent choice architecture nudges acceptance.
findings.evidence: The first layer offers “Manage options” and a prominent “Consent” button but no equally direct reject action, while blocking the whole page and listing 210 partners.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer equally prominent accept/reject controls on the first layer in the site language and keep granular settings secondary.

findings.summary: The registration email field lacks client-side required/error semantics.
findings.evidence: Signup DOM shows the email input is not required and has no aria-invalid state; empty submit triggers navigation rather than local actionable validation.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark the field required, validate after interaction, focus the error and announce a specific message with aria-describedby/live region.

findings.summary: Registration and sign-in forms omit or disable autocomplete.
findings.evidence: Signup email has no autocomplete token; login email has none and password sets autocomplete="off".
findings.suggestedFix: Use email/username, new-password and current-password autocomplete tokens and do not block password managers.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bandwidth.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 29 oversized, 54 without srcset and 52 legacy-format images; images transfer 5.08MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants, provide srcset/sizes and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Background advertising and analytics work is excessive.
findings.evidence: HAR records 90 fetch/XHR requests, 366 requests overall and 275 third-party requests during an idle load.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate and batch analytics, defer background auctions and eliminate redundant trackers/fetches.

findings.summary: Third-party resources dominate the page budget.
findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 5.49MB; 70 origins are contacted and 69 font files alone transfer 661KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, consolidate fonts and remove vendors whose user value does not justify their cost.

findings.guidanceId: bounded memory footprint javascript heap size page weight proportionate allocations
findings.summary: The idle page has a disproportionate memory footprint.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1,245,449 nodes and 77.35MB self size for a mostly static listings page; after repeated scrolling it reaches 80.14MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce third-party scripts, duplicate modules and retained ad objects; profile the largest native/code populations.
